text:
alex (ae): Heads up 0% GreenWave wants to kick off the POC but their procurement requires notarized MSA + PO before any production-like data. Can we propose alternatives?
tess (sales-eng): Quick check: POC price already approved in SF. Primary friction = notarization + HSM attestation ask. We should offer an accelerated path.
omar (legal): We can accept notarized signature, but prefer electronic notarization when possible. Two acceptable options: (A) e-notary via DocuSign/eID; (B) physical notarization with a scanned certificate up-front and originals mailed within 30 days. Limit notary to customer exec only.
maya (finance): If they insist on physical notarization and net45, we need PO and AR sign-off before provisioning. If they give PO referencing orderform we can provision after legal sign-off.
alex (ae): Can we give them a one-paragraph addendum that locks POC scope + price and says provisioning contingent on either e-notary OR scanned physical notary + PO?
omar (legal): Yes. Draft clause (suggested):
```
Notarization: Customer may execute this Agreement by (a) electronically notarized signature using an industry-standard e-notary service, or (b) physical notarization by Customer's authorized executive. If (b) is used, Customer shall provide a scanned notarization certificate at execution and deliver the original certificate to Vendor within thirty (30) days. The notarization requirement applies to Customer's executive signature only.
```
tess (sales-eng): Also need to address their DPA subprocessor bulletin: they want per-subprocessor prior consent. We should counter with notice + 30-day objection window.
omar (legal): Agreed. Counter text:
```
Subprocessors: Vendor may engage subprocessors. Vendor will provide notice of new subprocessors and Customer will have thirty (30) days to object in writing on legitimate data protection grounds. If parties cannot resolve the objection, the parties will negotiate in good faith and Customer may suspend transfer of Personal Data to the new subprocessor pending resolution.
```
maya (finance): Billing note: our default is net30. If Customer requires net45 for enterprise procurement we can accept for annual contracts but for a short POC we need PO before start. Please request PO referencing the Order Form.
docu-bot: :page_facing_up: Envelope 7f4c created (GreenWave_MSA_v2_redline.pdf, OrderForm_POC_GW.pdf). Status: awaiting customer signature.
alex (ae): I'll send the revised tracked changes + the two notarization options and ask for PO.
tess (sales-eng): I'll mention HSM attestation: we can provide an attestation letter from our infra team describing KMS/HSM controls but not low-level attestation docs. Will that satisfy them?
omar (legal): That's acceptable for POC. For production, we can discuss tight attestation requirements under a separate security addendum.
maya (finance): If they send PO with net30 we can provision immediately after signed MSA. If net45 but PO present we'll require finance approval and put provisioning on hold until approved.
alex (ae): Customer reply: "we prefer physical notary but can do scanned copy first. We will try to get PO this week"
tess (sales-eng): Great. I'll prelim DM to confirm billing contact and signer name.
omar (legal): I'll push the tracked-change MSA plus a one-line OrderForm addendum: scope = POC sandbox, seats = 2, duration = 30 days, price = $3,500, cancellation = automatic at end of period. Tagging @maya for billing terms.
maya (finance): Acknowledged. Will expedite approval if PO references OrderForm and net30.
alex (ae): Closing loop here 0 will update when PO or signed envelope arrives. Thanks everyone. :tada:
